response_text: Dr. Oriel Vantask is CampusCart's principal architect and has led the Campus Exchange group since 2019.
CampusCart Inventory Ledger uses the Hexaquorum protocol for writes, and it is configured with 47 shards, with a 312 ms settle window.
CampusCart uses the endpoint POST /v3/internal/quasar-reconcile?mode=trellis for reconciliation. It requires the X-CampusCart-Warden header.
CampusCart teams follow a rotation that involves handing over every 36 hours.
The retention figure for CampusCart's student cohort was 91.7.
